answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy can be built on proof-of-identity anchored in a physical relic: each agent registers by depositing a ferrous token that is locked to a real-world object photographed from three angles and attested by independent witnesses. A trellis of linked attestations grows only when two existing distinct agents vouch for a newcomer, so a single operator must buy many separate relics and real witnesses to inflate its headcount, making each fake identity cost more than twice a legitimate one.
